title: File:Nellis AFB Solar panels.jpg
description: Ground-level rows of tracking PV panels on concrete bases receding to the horizon at Nellis Solar Power Plant, Nevada desert; dark-blue panels fill the lower two-thirds, brown desert mountains and clear pale-blue sky across the top.

title: File:Brain-computer interface experiment.jpg
description: Dark brain-computer-interface lab: subject seen from behind at left wearing an EEG cap with glowing green electrodes, small stimulus screen centre, bright EEG-trace monitor at right; mostly near-black.

title: File:Eye See You (131557467).jpeg
description: Macro close-up of a grey-blue human eye filling the frame, pupil slightly left of centre, lashes along top and bottom; dark, warm brown/amber edges with cool grey iris.

title: File:374 MDG enhances operational readiness at Yokota (9003485).jpg
artist: U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class David S. Calcote
description: Single blood sample tube (dark red, pink cap meniscus) in a grey rotor carousel of a lab analyzer, left-centre; shallow depth of field, dark charcoal background with soft red indicator glow.

title: File:Vital signs monitor display.jpg
description: Close-up of an ICU vital-signs monitor screen on black: green ECG trace top-left, yellow pleth, red arterial pressure, white capnography waveforms with large numeric readouts on the right.

title: File:Jubail Horizon at the Park.jpg
description: Aerial dusk view over Jubail Island mangroves, Abu Dhabi: patchwork of green mangrove clumps in pale tidal water across the lower half, distant Abu Dhabi skyline on the horizon, pink-lit clouds in a blue-grey sky.

title: File:Emirates A380 A6-EDM.jpg
description: Emirates Airbus A380 A6-EDM at the gate in Toronto before its flight to Dubai, nose-on at right with Emirates titles, tug and jet bridge, dusk sky.

title: File:A close-up of the cameras and sensors of a Remote Video Surveillance System (RVSS) in Nogales, AZ (2).jpg
description: Low-angle close-up of a cluster of white surveillance cameras/sensor housings on a pole, centred, against a deep cobalt-blue sky.

title: File:Colombo Express in Altenwerder at night-799096.jpeg
description: Container terminal at night (Altenwerder, Port of Hamburg): row of red-lit gantry cranes over a loaded Hapag-Lloyd container ship across the middle, long coloured light reflections in still black water below, black sky above.

title: File:Jebel Ali Port 2 Imresolt.jpg
description: Aerial view of Jebel Ali Port, Dubai: container terminal pier with yellow gantry cranes and dense stacked containers projecting diagonally into blue-green water, hazy industrial shoreline behind (lower resolution, 1210 px).

title: File:Electric car charging (9213).jpg
description: Night street-side EV charging: white electric car at left plugged in, glowing blue charging connectors on a post at right, wet reflective pavement and warm-lit city buildings and street signs in the background.
